parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the user.

parameters.name: ZoneName
parameters.description: The name of the zone. This parameter is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz check-zone-name --lang en --zone-name example.com --user-client-ip 127.0.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
